verdict.rationale: Saving and sharing filtered views is a fair capability to ask of a work-tracking tool like Shortcut, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack never mentions saved views, saved filters, or shareable view links. Roadmaps, Iterations, and custom fields are adjacent planning features and do not count as saved filtered views.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can save a filtered view of work and share it with a link
